instructions.question: What emotional attitude does the poster of this Bosnian tweet convey: positive, neutral or negative?
instructions.rule: Annotators label even headlines and shared links by the valence of the event: good news (agreements, awards, progress, nice products) is positive, and bad news (assassination attempts, debt, drugs, wolves killing sheep, war crimes) is negative. Purely informational posts, ads, check-ins, programme announcements and odd personal observations with no clear feeling are neutral. Swearing, complaints, sadness, jealousy, disgust and self-deprecating 'I'm dying' jokes count as negative. Light humour, warmth, wishes and enthusiasm count as positive.

neutral.what: Factual announcements, TV or programme promos, election results, check-ins, links without evaluation, quirky everyday remarks and replies without clear emotion.
examples: I'm at Radon Plaza Hotel (Sarajevo, Bosnia)
CIK: Krstimir Pantić, G.I. SRPSKA: 37,26% ili 2233 glasova
Ja Jaffa keks jedem tako sto zubima pazljivo zgulim cokoladu... (I eat Jaffa biscuits by peeling off the chocolate...)
neutral.cues: gledajte (watch), u prodaji (on sale), I'm at, via @YouTube, ne znam (I don't know), +
neutral.not_for: News headlines with clearly good or bad content take positive or negative.

positive.what: Joy, love, longing for pleasant things, praise, playful contentment, or links and headlines about favourable developments.
examples: Ne znam za vas, ali ja jedva čekam snijeg. (I don't know about you, but I can't wait for snow.)
Magistrica iz Srebrenika nagrađena u Beču: Bosanka među 64 najbolja apsolventa (Master's graduate from Srebrenik awarded in Vienna)
Izglasano povjerenje grčkoj Vladi (Greek government wins confidence vote)
positive.cues: volim (I love), obožavam (I adore), jedva čekam (can't wait), predivno (wonderful), lijepo (nice), :) , <3, nagrađena (awarded), sila (awesome)
positive.not_for: Sarcastic 'obožavam kad' (I love it when) observations that carry no real joy are neutral. Affectionate teasing that uses curses or sad emoticons is negative.

negative.what: Anger, insults, swearing, sadness, frustration, boredom, jealousy, shame, or headlines about harmful or bad events.
examples: tuga da tuznije ne moze biti. (sadness, couldn't be sadder)
Dosadna fizika -_- (Boring physics)
Sirijski ministar preživio pokušaj atentata (Syrian minister survived assassination attempt)
negative.cues: jebem (f***), mrzim (I hate), tuga (sadness), umrem (I die), dosadna (boring), placem (I cry), stid me (I'm ashamed), :(, -_-
negative.not_for: Mild amused complaints with no real distress, such as 'Smijesni su mi taksisti' (taxi drivers amuse me), are neutral.
